question: Who won the women’s singles title at Wimbledon 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Elena Rybakina**____.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Elena Rybakina won the women’s title at Wimbledon 2022 by beating Ons Jabeur of Tunisia. Rybakina is the first player representing Kazakhstan to win a Grand Slam singles title. 
 
• She was born in Russia but switched nationalities to Kazakhstan in 2018 and she acquired Kazakh citizenship.
 
• The 23-year-old also became the youngest female player to win the title in Wimbledon since Petra Kvitova of Czech in 2011.
 
• The All England Lawn Tennis and Croquet Club is a private club founded on 23 July 1868, originally "The All England Croquet Club".
 
• In the spring of 1877, the club was renamed "The All England Croquet and Lawn Tennis Club".
 
• It is held every year at All England Lawn Tennis and Croquet Club in Wimbledon, London, the United Kingdom.
 
• Wimbledon is played on outdoor grass courts, with retractable roofs over the two main courts since 2019.
 
• During The Championships the height of the grass will be 8mm.
 
• 
 There are four Grand Slam tennis tournaments:

 
 
• Wimbledon Open- 1877
 
• Us Open- 1881
 
• French Open- 1891
 
• Australian Open- 1905
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

 
• 135th Wimbledon Championship 2022 has 14 sponsors, a few are Slazenger (being the oldest sponsor), IBM, HSBC, OPPO, Rolex, etc. The new sponsor added this year to the event is Vodafone.
 
• Soft drinks company Robinsons has ended its 86 years-long partnership with Wimbledon. Now it will not sponsor Wimbledon.
 
• Wimbledon consists of five main events, four junior events, and seven invitation events.
